content.short: Art representing culture on Cardano to onboard and educate as many people as possible. This is where crypto meets culture.
content.description:
The main point of this DAO is to educate and onboard as many people from as many cultures everywhere onto Cardano. What does, ‘Where crypto meets culture’ mean? What we mean by that is to educate the vast majority of the community, but to also aid the people in need across the many different cultures as well as to support projects building on Cardano through a governance-based funding mechanism.

We will act similarly to Catalyst in terms of funding but the difference will be that we will fund projects building as well as projects that already exist and that we will expect a % share back to the DAO treasury (The path in which the DAO takes will be, of course, voted upon by the members, whether it is to benefit the DAO, or to benefit others).
